t: No longer sign transfer-encoding header for SigV4
Adds internal support for the new 'auth' trait to allow a priority list of auth types for a service or operation.
SigV4QueryAuth and CrtSigV4QueryAuth now properly respect AWSRequest.params while signing boto/botocore`#2521 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/2521>`__
Fix an issue where mixed endpoint casing could cause a SigV4 signature mismatch.
